name: Okaa-san to no Himitsu ~Kekkon no Aisatsu ni Ittara, Senjitsu no Deriheru Jou Deshita...~
original_name: お義母さんとの秘密 ～結婚の挨拶に行ったら、先日のデリヘル嬢でした…。～
source:
Osanaita Taro has a girlfriend, Sayoko, whom he's been dating for three years. He proposed on her birthday, and they happily became engaged.

―――But the afterglow of happiness was short-lived.

“Once you're married, you won't be able to do anything! You better get your fill of fun while you still can!”

Feeling strangely persuaded by his colleague's words, Taro ended up booking an escort. There, he met the sex worker “Emiri.”

His fling with her would drastically shake up Taro's destiny— Because “Emiri” was none other than Sayoko's mother, Kimura Asako...

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt293/apt293.html#link_story]official site[/url]]
translation:
长坂太郎有一个女友小夜子，他已经和她交往了三年。他在她生日那天求婚，他们幸福地订婚了。

————但是幸福的余辉是短暂的。

“一旦结婚了，你就什么都做不了了！你最好趁还能玩的时候尽情享受！”

太郎奇怪地被同事的话说服了，最终他预约了一名陪护人员。在那里，他遇到了性工作者“埃米里”。

他与她的风流韵事将彻底改变太郎的命运——因为“埃米尔”不是别人，正是小夜子的母亲木村麻子……
